correctness.rationale: The edge-open-packing condition is equivalent to a disjoint union of induced selected stars on all selected endpoints. The neighborhood of any vertex of L(K_n) splits into two cliques, so these stars are K2 or P3; the represented K_n edges form disjoint 3-label P3 and 4-label P4 blocks, and the converse is exact. Three and twelve undirected paths on 3 and 4 prescribed labels give exponential weights z/2 and z^2/2, yielding the displayed coefficient sum. Optimizing 3a+4b over fixed a+2b proves the residue-class extremal formula, and substituting extremal profiles gives exact multiplicities. All labels n>=0 and degenerate graph cases are covered. A separate direct oracle exhaustively checks 21,517 edge-open packings for n=2..8; integer recurrences, degrees, and extremal coefficients agree through n=60; finite checks corroborate rather than prove the theorem.

value.rationale: The full all-cardinality polynomial for the standard infinite triangular-graph family goes beyond the previously studied maximum and general bounds. A graph-specific structural bijection converts the edge constraint into classical labeled path-block enumeration, yielding a concise exponential generating function, exact polynomial-time-in-output recurrence, and a sharp mod-four extremal anomaly with two distinct largest-packing types. These intrinsic enumeration and extremal features motivate this precise invariant; the result is not merely a routine numerical increment.
